{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "FULL WEBSITE PROMPT – PixelCamp Gaming Community Landing Page

Create a clean modern static marketing website for a small gaming community called PixelCamp. It should feel like a Dribbble-style concept shot: polished, soft glassmorphism cards, neon accents, rounded corners, smooth gradients, simple layout, not too complex. This is NOT a gaming app and NOT a playable game, just a static community website / landing page with sample content.

GENERAL STYLE
- Visual direction: glassmorphism + cozy gaming community
- Inspiration: Dribbble landing page designs, modern esports/community pages, soft neon UI
- Background: dark navy / purple gradient with subtle blur blobs
- Main colors: electric violet, cyan, soft pink, white text
- Mood: friendly, inclusive, casual gaming nights, community vibes
- Layout: responsive desktop + mobile
- Keep it simple and elegant, no overloaded dashboard
- Use static/mock content only
- No backend, no login, no database, no API, no real chat, no realtime features

TECH / DELIVERABLE
Build as a static React front-end page. It can be a single page website with sections. Use plain React components and CSS/Tailwind if available. Everything must render with local/static content only. Placeholder avatars, cards, fake events, fake stats are fine.

NAVIGATION
Sticky transparent/glass navbar at top:
- PixelCamp logo text with small gamepad-style icon (CSS/icon is fine)
- Links: Home, Events, Squads, Rules, Join
- CTA button: Join Discord Style Community (but do not connect to real Discord, just a static button)
Mobile nav can simply stack or collapse visually, no complex logic required.

HERO SECTION
Left side:
Small pill badge: Casual Gaming Community • Est. 2026
Big headline: Find Your Squad. Play Better Together.
Subtext: PixelCamp is a friendly community for casual players, weekend grinders, indie fans, and cozy co-op nights.
Buttons:
- Join the Camp
- View Events
Small trust row: 2,400+ Members • 18 Weekly Sessions • Zero Toxicity Vibe

Right side:
Glassmorphism feature card / mock community panel with:
- Online Tonight: 128 players
- Featured Games: Co-op Adventure, Tactical Arena, Cozy Builder, Racing Night
- Upcoming voice room: Friday Chill Queue
- Small avatar stack using colored circles or placeholder images
Add floating mini cards around it:
- New Squad Match +24
- Cozy Co-op Night
- Beginner Friendly

SECTION 2 – COMMUNITY STATS
Create 4 glass cards:
- 2.4K Members
- 18 Weekly Events
- 42 Active Squads
- 96% Friendly Rating
Each card should have a small icon, bold number, short label. Use sample data only.

SECTION 3 – WHY JOIN PIXELCAMP
Three or four feature cards with nice icons:
1. Squad Finder
Description: Meet players with the same pace, timezone, and game style.
2. Weekly Game Nights
Description: Static schedule cards for casual sessions, tournaments, and chill lobbies.
3. Beginner Safe
Description: No pressure, no flaming, helpful teammates and relaxed rules.
4. Creator Corner
Description: Share clips, screenshots, fan art, and setup photos.
Make cards frosted glass, hover glow, subtle border.

SECTION 4 – UPCOMING EVENTS
Static cards only, no calendar integration:
- Friday Chill Queue — Jun 05, 8:00 PM — Casual co-op lobbies and voice hangout
- Indie Discovery Night — Jun 08, 7:30 PM — Try new indie demos with the community
- Squad Scrim Lite — Jun 12, 9:00 PM — Friendly tactical practice, no rankings
- Screenshot Campfire — Jun 15, 6:00 PM — Share best in-game moments
Each event card should include a small tag like Casual, Co-op, Creative, Beginner.
Button: See Full Schedule (static link/button only)

SECTION 5 – SQUADS / PLAYER GROUPS
Show 3 squad cards:
- Night Owls — Late evening players, relaxed voice chat
- Cozy Controllers — chill games, builders, farming, exploration
- Ranked But Friendly — players who like improving without toxicity
Each card includes mock member count, vibe tags, and a CTA: View Squad (static).

SECTION 6 – COMMUNITY RULES
Simple rule list in a nice glass panel:
- Respect every player
- Keep voice chat welcoming
- No harassment or rage-baiting
- Help new members learn
- Share wins without flexing too hard
Add a short sentence: PixelCamp is built for people who want gaming to feel fun again.

SECTION 7 – TESTIMONIALS
Three short fake testimonials with avatars/initials:
- “I found a weekend squad in ten minutes and never felt judged.” — Maya, Cozy Builder Fan
- “Feels like a tiny internet campfire for gamers.” — Leo, Indie Explorer
- “Good players, no drama, great event design.” — Sam, Tactical Casual
Use glass quote cards.

SECTION 8 – FINAL CTA
Big centered frosted panel:
Headline: Ready to Pull Up a Chair?
Text: Join PixelCamp and find your next favorite squad, event, or late-night gaming friend.
Buttons:
- Join the Community
- Browse Events
Add small note: Static demo website — all content is sample.

FOOTER
Columns:
- PixelCamp short description
- Explore: Events, Squads, Rules, Join
- Community: Clips, Guides, Campfire, Support
- Social labels: Discord, Twitch, YouTube, X (static text links only)
Bottom: © 2026 PixelCamp. Static concept website.

DESIGN DETAILS
- Glass panels with backdrop blur, transparent borders, soft shadows
- Neon gradient buttons
- Subtle animated floating blobs if easy with CSS only
- Use modern font pairing, large headings, readable body text
- Strong spacing, polished card alignment
- Fully responsive: on mobile hero stacks, cards become one column, nav stays usable
- Make it feel like a finished Dribbble mockup translated into a real static site

IMPORTANT LIMITS
Do not add login, accounts, admin panel, database, live chat, real Discord API, real event API, server code, payment, WebGL, 3D, canvas game, or actual gameplay. This is only a static marketing landing page with mocked community content.",

  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
